Evelyn / Ben —

Thanks for the heads up, Evelyn. Quick AP intake notes so we can give Sunburst the right instructions:

Accepted paths (in order of preference):
1) Portal upload (preferred) — single PDF is fine; our system will ingest PO metadata from the portal fields.
2) Email fallback to invoices@redwood.com — please use subject: "Invoice: Sunburst Inc — PO <PO#>" and attach both the invoice PDF AND the CSV/Excel line-item file if there are multiple charge rows.

Minimal required fields for the line-item CSV (column headers we map automatically):
- po_number (string)
- invoice_number (string)
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- line_description (string)
- line_quantity (number)
- line_unit_price (decimal)
- line_total (decimal)
- tax_amount (decimal, optional)
- currency (USD)

If Sunburst cannot produce a line-level CSV, we can accept a single-line PDF for the first invoice but require a full CSV for recurring or >1 line invoices.

Filename convention for email fallback: Sunburst_INV_<PO#>_<invoice_number>.pdf (and the CSV matching the same prefix). This is important for automated matching.

I'll validate their draft invoice once they send it; if the W-9 and SOW are in order we'll fast-track activation.

Marissa Cole
AP Lead, Redwood Inference
